shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' -g '"'!*.lock'"' | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,320p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && sed -n '1,320p' app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx && sed -n '1,220p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && sed -n '1,400p' app/globals.css && sed -n '1,240p' lib/products.ts && sed -n '1,180p' package.json && sed -n '1,200p' next.config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"ViewTransition|viewTransition|unstable_ViewTransition\" node_modules/react node_modules/@types/react node_modules/next | sed -n '1,260p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,460p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && rg -n \"transitionTypes\" node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,160p' && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts && sed -n '1,120p' tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git log -5 --oneline --decorate 2>/dev/null || true && rg -n \"playwright|vitest|test\" . -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- package.json && git show HEAD:package.json && git status --short app lib tsconfig.json next.config.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/react/package.json').version\" && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" && node -e \"import('react').then(r => console.log(typeof r.ViewTransition, typeof r.addTransitionType))\""

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"react-dom-experimental|react-experimental|alias.*react|experimental.*viewTransition|viewTransition.*experimental\" node_modules/next/dist/build node_modules/next/dist/server node_modules/next/dist/shared | sed -n '1,260p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '260,330p' node_modules/next/dist/build/create-compiler-aliases.js && rg -n \"function getReactProfilingInProduction|bundledReactChannel|reactProductionProfiling\" node_modules/next/dist/build/create-compiler-aliases.js node_modules/next/dist -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,160p' && rg -n \"viewTransition\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.d.ts | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/next/dist/lib/needs-experimental-react.js && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/lib/needs-experimental-react.d.ts && rg -n \"needsExperimentalReact|ppr|dynamicIO|cacheComponents|view\" node_modules/next/dist/lib/needs-experimental-react.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | sed -n '1,180p'"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const a=require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react'); const b=require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental'); console.log('stable', a.version, typeof a.ViewTransition, typeof a.addTransitionType); console.log('experimental', b.version, typeof b.ViewTransition, typeof b.addTransitionType))\" && rg -n \"transitionIndicator\\??:\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.d.ts | sed -n '1,60p'"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const a=require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react'); const b=require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental'); console.log('stable', a.version, typeof a.ViewTransition, typeof a.addTransitionType); console.log('experimental', b.version, typeof b.ViewTransition, typeof b.addTransitionType)\" && rg -n \"transitionIndicator\\??:\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.d.ts | sed -n '1,60p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '560,620p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts && rg -n \"transitionIndicator\" node_modules/next/dist/docs node_modules/next/dist -g '*.md' -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '940,992p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts && rg -n \"ViewTransition|addTransitionType\" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.production.js node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/react.production.js | head -40"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true && git ls-files && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx app/globals.css && sed -n '1,160p' app/ProductGrid.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json && git diff --check && rg -n "ViewTransition|transitionTypes|prefers-reduced-motion|view-transition" app next.config.ts'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,160p' .gitignore && sed -n '1,80p' next-env.d.ts && git diff --stat && git diff --numstat"
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || command -v google-chrome || true; npm ls @playwright/test playwright puppeteer --depth=0 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm start'
/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D - http://127.0.0.1:3000/product/classic-sneakers -o /tmp/product-detail.html && sed -n '1,20p' /tmp/product-detail.html"
/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D - http://127.0.0.1:3000/ -o /tmp/product-home.html && sed -n '1,20p' /tmp/product-home.html"
/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:3000/product/not-a-product"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && npx tsc --noEmit && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx app/globals.css"
/bin/bash -lc 'git ls-files .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts package-lock.json && du -sh .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo 2>/dev/null'
/bin/bash -lc "git check-ignore -v .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts package-lock.json || true && git status --porcelain=v2 | sed -n '1,120p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git clean -fd -- .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short && git diff --check'

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx | sed -n '1,100p'; nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,100p'; nl -ba app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx | sed -n '1,130p'; nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '120,245p'; git diff --check; git status --short"
